d.ko: Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds!  Enjoy fast and frantic arcade-style beat 'em up gameplay with cute characters.  Beat up hordes of weird enemies with awesome special attacks.  Local co-op and PVP supported for up to 4 players!
d.en: Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds!  Enjoy fast and frantic arcade-style beat 'em up gameplay with cute characters.  Beat up hordes of weird enemies with awesome special attacks.  Local co-op and PVP supported for up to 4 players!
d.zh: Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds是一款像素风美少女动作类横版过关游戏，角色可爱的画风与流畅的点阵动画是本作的最大特征。不断强化追加可用角色，打败各种千奇百怪的敌人吧！游戏同时支持最大4人的本地合作模式与PVP模式。
